sources.title: Vision Encoders in Vision-Language Models: A Survey - jina.ai
sources.snippet: This survey analyzes vision encoders across 70+ vision-language models from 2023–20251 and finds that training methodology matters more than encoder size: improvements in loss functions, data curation, and feature objectives yield larger gains than scaling by an order of magnitude.
